title: User-designated public voice references
principle: The user assigns each public account as a creative personality/voice reference for a fictional GEEHUB character. These mappings are user-directed. Account-derived traits must only be added after the referenced public material has been directly reviewed; until then, character voice remains grounded in established GEEHUB canon.

evidenceBoundary.note: Direct profile pages for X and Instagram were inaccessible to the current web viewer on 2026-11-09. Search indexing did not provide a reliable, representative set of posts for all five accounts. No specific account personality traits are asserted as verified findings.
evidenceBoundary.nextStep: Review a representative selection of public posts, captions, replies, and media from each account. Capture source URLs and dates, then identify recurring public-facing cadence, humour, topics, emotional register, conversational stance, and expression. Keep observations separate from character interpretation.

userEstablishedCanon.boundaries: Do not infer team, position, playing level, exact measurements, regional origin, accent, or private details from the public profile.

userEstablishedMapping.boundary: The account mapping does not establish private feelings, intentions, or relationship facts. Review public videos and descriptions before adding account-derived traits.

interpretationProtocol: Quote or paraphrase only the public post being examined, with link and date.
Observe speech and posting style; do not infer private psychology, health, relationships, or other sensitive details.
Separate source observation from the GEEHUB character adaptation.
Do not imitate exact phrases, catchphrases, or distinctive creative expression; translate broad cadence and interaction patterns into original dialogue.
Keep the existing canon unless the user explicitly requests a change.
